reviewer_type: AI visual audit by Codex, with existing user-confirmed target identities
criterion: The selected region identifies the intended physical equipment or user-defined assembly, not merely another object of the same class. Boundary spill and incomplete coverage are recorded separately and are not judged using input-SAM IoU as a correctness threshold.
evidence_reviewed: All ten 1800x1472 review sheets: original reference photograph and selected SAM, calibrated reference Gaussian rendering, two other calibrated photographs/renderings, and the text-only selection's own inspection view. Three-dimensional centers and Gaussian membership were checked as corroborating evidence.

cases.notes: Intended black assembly and white base beside the curved yellow aisle marking. Text-only selects another white assembly workstation in a different row; no intended-instance membership overlap. Assisted selection tracks the designated station in both other views.

Both select the designated long white wheeled base with upright posts. Other views confirm the same station despite foreground cabinet occlusion. Correct identity does not imply precise boundary segmentation.

Intended cooler stands beside the green noticeboard and stacked crates on the aisle edge. Text-only selects the separate cooler in the middle of the aisle. Both instances are distinguishable in the same photographs.

Both select the designated central-aisle cooler. This is the same physical cooler as M1-09 observed from the opposite direction; 98.998% of M1-04 selected Gaussians are also in M1-09. Not an independent physical-target replicate.

Intended large gray wheeled frame/assembly stand at the end of the aisle. Text-only selects a white assembly carrier in the adjacent production row. The two other views show spatially separate selections.

Intended narrow cooler alongside the metal storage racks, seen from the side. Text-only returns the central-aisle cooler, as in M1-03 with the identical text. Assisted selection tracks the rack-side object.

Both identify the intended stacked frame/container assembly and adjacent selected small stand. Text-only includes extra extent; instance identity is correct, boundary quality remains unscored. The stored crate description is imperfect for the selected metal-rack assembly.

Intended black assembly on a white machine base. Text-only selects a broad, unrelated rack/roller region at another position. Stored text says belt conveyor, while the selected reference object is an assembly station; semantic-description mismatch is a confound, not solely same-class instance ambiguity.

Both identify the central-aisle cooler including its lower tank. It is the same physical cooler as M1-04, viewed from the opposite direction. Kept as a separate confirmed M1 task but clustered together for unique-target sensitivity analysis.

Intended narrow wheeled slatted frame at the far aisle end; text-only selects the central-aisle cooler instead. Assisted selection matches the user-designated frame. The stored air-cooler text does not cleanly describe the visible target; this qualitative case includes semantic-description mismatch, not just ambiguity between identical coolers.
